title: 任务与经济系统失衡
description: 任务报酬、罚款和费用设置不合理，导致经济困难或收益失衡，如送货任务报酬差距过大、巡逻罚款过高、船员死亡费用难以承担。
evidence: you have delivery gigs that pay you 1500, and the same delivery gigs that pay you 10mil. So, why would I salvage anything in this game about salvaging things, when I can just travel from A to B and make 2000% more profit?
two successive taillight fines from two different patrols about 30 minutes apart for 2x $28K
i hired a crewmate and theres a death fee, which is basically life insurance, its 50k, and i only had 20k, and theres interest

evidence_items.quote: you have delivery gigs that pay you 1500, and the same delivery gigs that pay you 10mil. So, why would I salvage anything in this game about salvaging things, when I can just travel from A to B and make 2000% more profit?
evidence_items.description: 任务报酬按距离平衡，导致相同送货任务报酬从1500到1000万不等，使打捞变得无意义
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你有报酬为1500的送货任务，也有同样的送货任务报酬为1000万。那么，在这个关于打捞东西的游戏中，我为什么要去打捞任何东西，当我可以直接从A点旅行到B点并多赚2000%的利润？

evidence_items.quote: i hired a crewmate and theres a death fee, which is basically life insurance, its 50k, and i only had 20k, and theres interest
evidence_items.description: 雇佣船员死亡费用高达5万，玩家只有2万且需支付利息
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我雇了一个船员，还有个死亡费用，基本上就是人寿保险，要 5 万，而我只有 2 万，还有利息

evidence_items.quote: two successive taillight fines from two different patrols about 30 minutes apart for 2x $28K
evidence_items.description: 巡逻队罚款过高，导致经济困难
evidence_items.quote_zh: 大约30分钟内，连续两次被两个不同的巡逻队开尾灯罚单，每次2.8万美元，共两次
